## Spec compliance

✅ Captured base/head identities cross task, post-rebase seam, check-fix, final single/cluster/seam, ordinary CLI, assembler, and roast PR interfaces. Existing Finish ledger dispatch captures final-review source without adding another dispatch. Failed final source capture produces unavailable review rather than a moving-ref fallback.

✅ Review instructions use pinned Git retrieval and permit unique review-owned detached filesystem views and isolated mutable output/temp directories. Caller differences are observations requiring evidence, with no automatic attribution or restore. Task review retains its no-test-run rule. Supplied roast patch/stat-only data remains supported with repository access gated on captured identities.

✅ Deterministic advancing-caller and independent-reproduction fixtures plus a concrete parent evaluation scenario are supplied. The super-auto and report-verdict caller adaptations are related interface work.

⚠ Parent-owned fresh-agent behavioral acceptance remains outstanding: task-1-report.md, “Parent-owned behavioral acceptance scenario.” The report explicitly distinguishes deterministic fixtures and simulated Workflow evidence from actual independent agent adherence. Complete and record that evaluation before accepting the enclosing epic.
